Usage: workscribe _capture [options]

Internal: capture a shell command or IDE event (called by shell hook or IDE
plugin)

Options:
  --cmd <command>          command that was executed (shell events)
  --cwd <path>             working directory
  --exit <code>            exit code
  --duration <ms>          duration in milliseconds
  --git-before <sha>       git HEAD SHA before this command ran
  --type <type>            event type override — skips normalization (IDE
                           integrations)
  --source <source>        event source identifier (e.g. vscode, neovim,
                           jupyter)
  --file <path>            file path for code_edit events
  --lines-added [count]    lines a code_edit added
  --lines-removed [count]  lines a code_edit removed
  -h, --help               display help for command
